headline.text: L1 S1 belt fraying with multiple findings in product zone — line continued under *enhanced monitoring* after maintenance trim.

summary: Two active foreign-material risks: L1 S1 belt threads found repeatedly near depositor and tunnel, L3 ML1 belt C2 cut throughout discovered during clean. L1 S2 Tate's rework held pending X-ray verification after no initial checks performed.

holds.title: Tate's Dark rework held for X-ray verification
holds.summary: Rework from prior run requires X-ray verification before release because no verification checks were performed on the X-ray during original production.
holds.status: On hold pending X-ray verification check by QA; scheduled for Monday after S2 level 4 clean completes.

food_safety.title: S1 belt material found in product zone — multiple occurrences
food_safety.summary: Operators found belt threads near tunnel 1 at 15:25 MT and again at 17:13 MT; maintenance trimmed loose pieces during MD check, line continued with 5 EEs monitoring.
food_safety.status: Open — line running under enhanced monitoring; third shift expected to replace belt tonight or tomorrow.

food_safety.title: ML1 belt C2 cut throughout discovered during clean
food_safety.summary: Maintenance found belt C2 has a cut running the length of the belt during morning reassembly; belt was in service prior to level 2 clean.
food_safety.status: Open — belt damage documented, ATP testing completed and line cleared to run; no product hold initiated.

food_safety.title: Truffle bottomer wire mesh damaged overnight
food_safety.summary: Bottomer wire mesh torn during 2nd shift operation; maintenance repaired by 07:36 MT before startup.
food_safety.status: Resolved — mesh repaired, line running; no product held.

quality.title: S3 Pecan MMK label quality issues — ridges, bubbles, wrinkles
quality.summary: All three lots of Pecan MMK labels showed ridges or poor adhesion; QA accepted small bubbles/wrinkles outside main display panel after 50-jar test with Salted Caramel labels passed.
quality.status: Resolved — running Labeler B with Lot 1, minor cosmetic defects accepted; Labeler A material issue confirmed.

quality.title: S4 caramel texture dry during startup
quality.summary: QA flagged dry caramel texture and cutting issues; approximately 15 minutes of production reviewed and accepted, subsequent batches normal.
quality.status: Resolved — texture returned to normal, production continued.

sanitation.title: Truffle level 2 clean passed ATP
sanitation.summary: Level 2 clean completed and ATP testing passed at 07:33 MT.

sanitation.title: ML1 level 2 clean passed ATP
sanitation.summary: Level 2 clean completed and ATP testing passed; QA signed off at 07:45 MT.

sanitation.title: ML4 environmental swabs completed for inclusion & cold stamp
sanitation.summary: Three environmental swabs completed for inclusion plate/parts and three for cold stamp plates; all routine midnight shift verification.
sanitation.status: Completed — all swabs taken, results pending.

opportunities.text: Consider adding belt inspection to S1 startup and mid-shift checks — today's fraying belt required multiple interventions and raised FM risk during production.
Verify X-ray safety-chain verification is captured for all rework batches — today's Tate's Dark rework was created without initial X-ray checks recorded.
Review ML1 belt inspection protocol during reassembly — the C2 cut was discovered by maintenance post-clean rather than during visual inspection before startup.
